description: Linear Beats: lets only one trigger strike at a time across nine channels of gates, turning coincident drum triggers into a linear pattern

params.text: Sets how that channel behaves: green blocks its gate when a channel above goes high at that moment, dark passes every gate, orange blocks coincident gates but not those below, white starts a new group

inputs.text: Gates for that lettered channel, read as Schmitt triggers going high at 1V and low at 0.1V. A takes precedence over B and so on, and within a polyphonic cable the lower numbered channels do
Gates are looked at only on a rising edge here, which lines up inputs that are not sample-accurate. Delay it at least as much as the latest input, and run it at twice the fastest channel

outputs.text: Carries the gates of its lettered channel that were not blocked, 10V high and 0V low

menu: Expander CV toggles button on/off — off, a high gate at a Linear Beats Expander mutes and a low gate unmutes; on, each rising edge flips the mute instead
Add left Linear Beats expander — places a Linear Beats Expander immediately to the left, where it mutes the inputs
Add right Linear Beats expander — places a Linear Beats Expander immediately to the right, where it mutes the outputs

inputs.9: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
